verdict.rationale: Change tracking is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents deployment markers, release annotations, or configuration-change tracking tied to regressions. Generic correlation and root-cause analysis and the existence of CI/CD integrations are adjacent features, not release or change tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking
